This matches the key-map coverage given in task.json, which puts sheet 84 at x 2045-2430 (G..J) and sheet 95 at x 3230-3590 (N 1/2..P) - widely disjoint bands; although the two sheets occupy adjacent key-map rows in y (42ND ST), they sit in entirely different avenue columns and are not stacked neighbours at all. The proposed candidates are mid-block 20-ft alleys on both sheets besides (sheet 84 cand1 1569 and cand2 2586 fall between 812|814 and 912|914; sheet 95 cand1 1562 falls between 1711|1713 and cand2 522 between 1611|1613, each beside a printed 20'), so pairing any of them would tie avenues five or more block columns - some 5000 native px - apart.
